posts.cooked: Yep, even Amazon, usually the late bloomer.  Just played my first game.  Fixed Point has some interesting interactions with several of these guys, and oddly, most of them bad.  Fixed Point + From the Brink or Regeneration is pretty sweet.  Fixed Point + Bored Now is bugged (report submitted).  Also Regeneration in Vengeance mode is ridiculous.  Went from Mainstay at 1 and everyone else at 5 or less to Mainstay at 4 and Medico in the high teens.  I had everyone beaten but Greazer, who wasn't even hurt, and figured I'd just win when Mainstay went down.  Then Mainstay didn't go down and Greazer got karate chopped for 18.  Weird team, weird game.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I discovered a wonderful interaction today while trying out digital Void Guard.

Give Writhe Twist the Ether.

When he uses the power that lets him do extra damage, but sacrifices the Shadow Cloak, just change it all to melee. Or cold. Or whatever. It only checks to see what type of damage has been dealt, not how many instances of damage, and between TTE and the Cloak itself, that's base 9 damage to one target! :D
